title: Duck & Cube Rhythm Conductor
description: The user acts as a rhythm conductor controlling a musical stage where a Duck performer and an AnimatedMorphCube act as synchronized dancers. By adjusting tempo, morph intensity, orbit radius, bounce height, rotation axis, and color pulse parameters through an interactive panel, the user choreographs an increasingly complex animation sequence that must hit specific visual beat targets to complete the performance.
prompt: Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 (via importmap from cdn.jsdelivr.net) that loads both Duck.glb and AnimatedMorphCube.glb from their paths. Set up a dark stage scene with a reflective MeshStandardMaterial ground plane, three colored SpotLights (magenta, cyan, gold) aimed at center stage, and a PerspectiveCamera at position (0, 3, 8) looking at origin. Use OrbitControls for camera. Place the Duck at (-1.5, 0, 0) scaled to 1.5 and the AnimatedMorphCube at (1.5, 0.5, 0). Play the cube's morph target animation via AnimationMixer. Create a dat.GUI or custom HTML control panel with these parameters: (1) 'tempo' slider 0.1-3.0 controlling the global animation timeScale on both mixers, (2) 'morphIntensity' slider 0.0-1.0 that scales the morph cube's morph target influences, (3) 'orbitRadius' slider 0.5-4.0 making the Duck orbit around the cube in a circle at that radius using sin/cos in the animation loop, (4) 'bounceHeight' slider 0.0-3.0 adding a vertical sine-wave bounce to the Duck using Math.abs(Math.sin(time * tempo)) * bounceHeight, (5) 'rotationAxis' dropdown (X, Y, Z) selecting which axis the cube spins on at tempo speed, (6) 'colorPulse' toggle that when enabled modulates the three spotlight intensities sinusoidally offset by 120 degrees creating a rhythmic color wash. Add a 'Performance Score' display that validates: tempo must be above 1.5, morphIntensity above 0.6, orbitRadius between 2.0-3.0, bounceHeight above 1.5, rotationAxis set to Y, and colorPulse enabled. When all six conditions are met simultaneously, display a 'Perfect Choreography!' banner with a CSS animation and spawn 20 small sphere particles that burst outward from center stage and fade. Use requestAnimationFrame loop with clock.getDelta for smooth animation. Ensure both GLB models load with GLTFLoader before starting the render loop.
